timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In the middle of the day, we have several entry points into,
if you want to come and do business, and in the area of Agriq specifically,
we have three teams working from different areas.
First, I have a special advisor on agriculture,
Prince Joe Kudew, who happened to have been the former Commissioner of Agriculture.
We have the Minister of Agriculture, who is a Commissioner and his team,
and then also have the PPP Office, the Public Private Partnership Office,
and then we have a business bureau.
So there are several points of entry where you can engage with us on the type of opportunities.
But typically, what we are doing, what we've tried to do, is to say,
look, what does well in those states.
So we are mapping the entire states.
Fortunately, we have a bit of information and data.
Soil analysis, rainfall patterns, agronomic reports,
to help, will be investors, have enough information to make enlightened decisions
on what to do.
We also are trying to highlight specific areas on crops where we have an advantage
and they run a proper process.
So in the area of all palm, for instance, we are currently finalizing our master plan
on agriculture with specific reference to all palm.
We have an institution from Indonesia that's working with us on this.
Once it's completed, we will have identified the areas where we want to look at land for all palm.
We will have finalized our community action program with the communities involved in those areas.
We will have an infrastructure plan so that when we publish for expressions of interest,
people will be able to apply and will explain and work with them on how they can make investments.
We want to use that as a model to help investors reduce the risks.
Rather than just give them land, typically what we found is that it's not that governments have not responded to investors' requirements.
But if you say, for instance, I want a thousand or two thousand hectares for a particular type of farm.
And I look at it to you, I give you the CFO.
But there's no infrastructure, there's no road to it.
The cost of you are building your road into the place.
I mean it will into it and then it will make the project unprofitable.
